what: Table 18 (Deaths from each cause by race and sex, each State) lines read by eye from the printed volumes, for the two Miller series Table 19 does not carry: smallpox (List No. 6) and List Nos. 196-198 (wounds of war, execution of civilians by belligerent armies, legal executions), which Miller's accidents_violence (172-198) includes. Zero where the volume prints dashes. Checked: the states add up to the printed United States line in each year (smallpox 34 and 48; 196-198: 143 and 187).
source: Vital Statistics of the United States 1937 Part I and 1938 Part I (US Bureau of the Census), Table 18; PDF pages 396-459 (1937) and 395-458 (1938) of the CDC/NCHS scans in sources/vsus_1937_1938/
